# ClinicOps

ClinicOps is a Danish-led, EU-wide evidence-controlled clinical and life-sciences operations company. Denmark is the local-market and localisation anchor; delivery is English-first and EU-wide, with Danish language, authority and professional expertise brought into scope when relevant.

Core pages:
- ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/ - Keep EUDAMED, UDI, certificates, SS(C)P and controlled regulatory records aligned when products change. ClinicOps reconciles approved sources against downstream regulated records and produces a reviewer-ready closure queue.
- About ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/about.html - Who is behind ClinicOps: Ali Iskandar, MSc in Medicine (Translational Medicine), with hands-on pharmacovigilance, Pharma and MedTech documentation experience, 500+ regulated assignments and native Danish regulatory-language capability.
- Scope a ClinicOps Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/assessment-intake.html - Build a concise ClinicOps clinical-operations review scope brief in your browser, then open it in your email client. No form data is transmitted by this page.
- Contact ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/contact.html - Contact ClinicOps to scope a Regulatory Change Integrity Review, a portfolio integrity scan, Denmark market access or Danish pharmacovigilance support.
- Solution | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/services.html - One flagship workflow: the Regulatory Change Integrity Review — an approved change reconciled against EUDAMED, UDI, certificates, SS(C)P and controlled records, delivered as a reviewer-ready closure packet. Portfolio scans enter it; monitoring extends it.
- Use Cases | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/use-cases.html - Where EU MedTech regulatory data integrity is applied: EUDAMED and UDI data, SS(C)P operations, Class III MDR transition, authorised-representative portfolios, document control, language versions and Denmark market access.

Solution and use cases:
- EU Authorised Representative Portfolio Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/authorised-representative-portfolio-intelligence.html - A repeatable evidence-reconciliation and transition-prioritisation layer for authorised representatives and regulatory consultancies managing MedTech portfolios.
- Class III and Implantable MDR Transition Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/class-iii-transition.html - Portfolio mapping, legacy versus MDR registration paths, certificate and transition timing queues, and SS(C)P duty context for class III and implantable device transitions.
- Denmark Market Access | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/denmark-market-access.html - Denmark market-access support for medical devices and IVDs: Danish authority mapping, controlled localisation and language-version integrity, evidence reconciliation, Danish pharmacovigilance support and EU-aligned handoffs.
- EU MDR Regulatory Data Integrity for Global MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eu-mdr-regulatory-integrity.html - Evidence-controlled EU MDR regulatory information review, remediation and change operations for medical-device manufacturers worldwide supporting the EU market.
- EUDAMED Transition Work Plans for MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eudamed-transition.html - Turn legacy and MDR portfolio evidence into a prioritised EUDAMED transition work plan with role-aware screening, evidence gaps and human regulatory review.
- Regulatory Change Integrity Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/evidence-change-control-pack.html - A focused ClinicOps engagement that turns one declared change and evidence population into a reviewer-ready source register, change-surface matrix, unresolved queue and closure packet.
- Specialist Clinical Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/expert-network.html - ClinicOps can introduce independent clinical subject-matter review — across medicine and nursing — when a regulatory, safety or product-information question requires clinical context beyond the core review. Specialists are selected for the question, credential-checked per engagement and disclosed to the client.
- Regulatory Integrity Review for MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-gate.html - Human-reviewed regulatory information reconciliation and change-propagation review across EUDAMED, IFU, SS(C)P, labels and client-controlled systems.
- Medical Device Regulatory Document Control | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/medical-device-document-control.html - Reconciliation-as-evidence review of consistency across EUDAMED records, IFU, labelling and market-language versions for MedTech, with RA/QA retaining sign-off.
- EU Medical Device Regulatory Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/regulatory-intelligence.html - Evidence-controlled EU medical device regulatory intelligence: capture signals, preserve actor context, separate screening from conclusions, and hand RA/QA a reviewable action plan.
- SS(C)P Operations and Evidence Workflows | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/sscp-operations.html - Organise SS(C)P evidence, Basic UDI-DI relationships, translations and operational handoffs with a human-reviewed MedTech regulatory work plan.

Free browser-local tools and examples:
- Change Surface Mapper | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/change-surface-mapper.html - Map one approved change across affected systems, records, documents and owners in your browser. Build a portable evidence brief without uploading inputs to ClinicOps.
- EUDAMED Identifier Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/identifier-check.html - Free, browser-only EUDAMED Identifier Check: B-prefix legacy screening, SRN actor-role decoding, and GS1 Mod-10 validation. Nothing is sent to ClinicOps.
- Free Regulatory Change Integrity Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-check.html - Build a browser-local evidence packet for one regulatory change: reference provenance, downstream comparison, evidence gaps, owner routing and a portable JSON fingerprint. No upload.
- Regulatory Change Review Cost Calculator | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-economics.html - Estimate the current manual workload and labour cost of checking regulatory change propagation across EUDAMED, IFU, SS(C)P, labels and controlled systems. Runs locally in your browser.
- Regulatory Integrity Scanner | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-scanner.html - Browser-local regulatory data integrity scanner: check one approved change against downstream records, or scan a portfolio export (CSV/JSON) for missing fields, duplicates and conflicting values. Deterministic, exportable, nothing uploaded.
- Transition Readiness Score | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/readiness-score.html - A private, browser-only screening aid for organising EUDAMED transition work-plan evidence before a human regulatory review.
- Regulatory Change Impact Mapper | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/regulatory-change-impact.html - Pick a category of recent EU regulatory change, answer six portfolio questions, and get a deterministic impacted-surface checklist with severity bands and an evidence-review queue. Browser-local; nothing is uploaded.
- Interactive Regulatory Integrity Specimen Register | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/specimen-register/ - Explore a synthetic ClinicOps integrity register: traceable reference evidence, observations, discrepancy states, review owners and explicit human decisions. No client data.
- Technical File Consistency Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/technical-file-consistency.html - Paste the same key fact as it appears in up to five technical-documentation sources and get a deterministic, severity-banded divergence report with an evidence queue. Browser-local; nothing is uploaded.
- Tools & Evidence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/tools.html - Browser-local regulatory data integrity tools: the Regulatory Integrity Scanner, EUDAMED identifier check, focused change and consistency utilities, and sanitized specimens. Nothing you enter leaves your browser.
- ClinicOps Class III Transition Map — Sanitized Sample: https://clinicops.dk/transition-map-sample/ - Sanitized fictional sample of the ClinicOps Class III Transition Map work-plan format.

- The published SS(C)P and the public EUDAMED record — what a reader can and cannot reconcile | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/research/sscp-public-record-scan/ - Public-source scan, September 2026: what a published SS(C)P and the public EUDAMED record can and cannot reconcile — identifiers, revisions, legacy DIs and pack records.

Policies:
- Privacy Notice | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/privacy-notice/ - How ClinicOps processes personal data: website, email enquiries, client engagements, and business-development outreach, including your right to object.

Operating boundaries:
- ClinicOps structures evidence, reconciliation and operational change; it does not turn machine findings into legal, regulatory, clinical, safety, quality or compliance determinations.
- Missing public records or links do not by themselves establish non-compliance.
- Source authority, professional judgement and release decisions remain explicit human responsibilities.
- Public-source coverage is bounded by the declared method and evidence population.
- Independent experts are engaged only within a defined project scope after credential, availability and conflict checks; their participation does not transfer reserved professional authority to ClinicOps.
